query_digests.digest_text: SELECT EVENT_ID,LEFT(SQL_TEXT,?) AS sql_text,NESTING_EVENT_TYPE,NESTING_EVENT_LEVEL,ROWS_EXAMINED,ROWS_SENT,ROWS_AFFECTED,NO_INDEX_USED,NO_GOOD_INDEX_USED,CREATED_TMP_TABLES,CREATED_TMP_DISK_TABLES,SORT_MERGE_PASSES,SELECT_FULL_JOIN,SELECT_SCAN,LOCK_TIME,TIMER_WAIT,ERRORS,WARNINGS FROM performance_schema.events_statements_history WHERE THREAD_ID = PS_CURRENT_THREAD_ID() AND EVENT_ID > ? query_digests.digest_text: SELECT @@performance_schema AS performance_schema,(SELECT ENABLED FROM performance_schema.setup_consumers WHERE NAME = ?) AS current_consumer,(SELECT ENABLED FROM performance_schema.setup_consumers WHERE NAME = ?) AS history_consumer,(SELECT INSTRUMENTED FROM performance_schema.threads WHERE THREAD_ID = PS_CURRENT_THREAD_ID()) AS instrumented,(SELECT COALESCE(MAX(EVENT_ID),?) FROM performance_schema.events_statements_history WHERE THREAD_ID = PS_CURRENT_THREAD_ID()) AS event_id

routing.text: ProxySQL answers this statement itself, before any rule, so the digest names mf_admin's default hostgroup 30.
why: MySQL_Session.cpp replies to it without a backend (handler_special_queries; SELECT @@version and SELECT VERSION() by mysql-select_version_forwarding).
